description: This file contains validation functions for flow structures, including validating flow nodes and edges, detecting cycles, and ensuring flow integrity in a flow-based system.

methods.name: validateFlow
methods.description: Validates the overall flow structure, checking for empty flow, start node presence, multiple start nodes, disconnected nodes, and cycles.

methods.name: detectCycle
methods.description: Detects if there is a cycle in the flow graph using DFS with color marking.

methods.name: validateNode
methods.description: Validates individual flow nodes for required fields and inputs.
